document_host.note: HYBRID: the register is Ocella, the documents are Civica Portal360 on this separate host. Use the reference-keyed Civica scheme - RefType PLANNINGCASE, KeyText=<raw reference>, KeyNumb=0 - not the number-keyed one. The Ocella showDocuments module is decommissioned, so this host is the only document route. No WAF on either host.

reference_format.note: 06/YY/NNNN/TYPE. Pass the raw reference, slashes included, as the Civica KeyText.

browser_route.note: Not needed for retrieval - the chain is scriptable - but this is the document-side deep link to hand a user, with <REF> the raw reference.

endpoints.note: Ocella base has NO /aplanning/ prefix, and search plus detail work verbatim there. Documents come from the Civica host instead, with the reference-keyed body {"KeyNumb":0,"KeyText":"<raw ref>","RefType":"PLANNINGCASE","ProcessNo":"","PageSize":50}. The whole chain is stateless.

quirks.summary: The Ocella showDocuments module is decommissioned and returns an EMPTY 200 page with no error - the documents are on the Civica host.
quirks.detail: Search and detail stay on Ocella and work normally, which makes the empty documents page read as 'this application has no documents'.
quirks.workaround: Take documents from portal.document_host. PlanIt's docs_url pointing at the Civica viewer is the automatic tell that the module moved.

quirks.summary: On the Civica host, FullTextSearch is silently ignored and the whole 30,992-row register comes back as if it were the result.
quirks.detail: The honoured field on this install is searchFields:{"KeyNo":"<ref>"}.
quirks.workaround: Always check TotalRows equals the expected count before using the result.

quirks.summary: Scanned batch documents (DocSource 'S') carry no FileName - label them from DocDesc.
The authority is mid-migration between products - watch for the register itself moving to Civica.
quirks.detail: Re-resolve the vendor at run time rather than assuming the Ocella register is still in place.

source_notes:
HYBRID: Ocella register + Civica Portal360 documents. Ocella search/detail verbatim (no /aplanning/ prefix; PlanIt url = ready planningDetails deep link) BUT showDocuments returns an EMPTY 200 page — the Ocella docs module is decommissioned. Documents via Recipe B against https://portal.great-yarmouth.gov.uk/civica/Resource/Civica/Handler.ashx/ with the REFERENCE-KEYED scheme: RefType PLANNINGCASE, KeyText=<raw ref>, KeyNumb=0 (doc/list body {"KeyNumb":0,"KeyText":"<ref>","RefType":"PLANNINGCASE","ProcessNo":"","PageSize":50}); download doc/pagestream?DocNo=<n>&pdf=true. Civica-side FullTextSearch SILENTLY IGNORED (returns whole 30,992-row register — check TotalRows); honoured field: searchFields:{"KeyNo":"<ref>"}. Scanned batch docs (DocSource 'S') lack FileName — use DocDesc. .docx sources converted to real PDF by pdf=true. Whole chain stateless, no WAF on either host. User deep link: https://portal.great-yarmouth.gov.uk/planning/search-applications#VIEW?RefType=PLANNINGCASE&KeyText=<raw-ref>. PlanIt quirks: applics reference field null (ref lives in uid); docs_url = the Civica viewer link (the automatic hybrid tell). Ref format 06/YY/NNNN/TYPE.

Watch for a full Civica migration.

verification.note: Ocella search and detail verbatim; documents retrieved from the Civica host with the reference-keyed scheme. Native .docx sources came back as real PDFs via pdf=true, so the downloaded files were inspected, not just counted.
Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (ocella)
